en: The first big boundary large language models
had at the beginning
was the cutoff date. So the cutoff date for
the information the model was trained with
and therefore the knowledge it had. If the
cutoff date was 2023, then any
more recent information was not available to
the model and therefore it couldn't provide
correct and up-to-date answers.
This problem was solved when large language
models gained web access. Those are
integrated tools
which allow
our large language models to access the
internet and therefore to retrieve current
information.
ChatGPT has this tool integrated and it may
search automatically in the web depending on
your prompt. But you can of course also ask
explicitly to use the web search. Now, for
example, you could use a prompt like this.
So we want to have the latest European

hold, and 3 implications for a finance team.

Interest rate decision is something that is
